SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_ids,
       MIN(order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

WITH day_orders AS (
  SELECT o.* FROM fact_web_order o
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
),
line_info AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id,
         COUNT(*) AS lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.store_id = 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS store999_lines,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.store_id = 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS store900_lines
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM day_orders)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders,
       COUNT(l.receipt_id) AS with_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.test_lines > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_with_test,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.test_lines = l.lines THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_all_test,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.store999_lines > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_store999,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.line_count <> l.lines THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing
FROM day_orders o LEFT JOIN line_info l ON l.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
